title: Bram and the Smile
author: Theo Kavanagh
blurb: August Crane, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
